rounds.text: Ramky Infrastructure is significantly under-appreciated by the market, trading at an attractive P/E of 12.9x [E1] and an even lower 9.05x against a sector benchmark of 13.85x [E6]. This valuation disconnect is further underscored by a discounted cash flow model indicating an intrinsic value of Rs 1955 per share against a market price of Rs 376 [E45], leaving a massive margin of safety of 80.8% [E46]. The company's underlying fundamentals are outpacing the stock price [E56], highlighted by a robust 5-year compounded profit growth of 31% [E19] and strong recent performance including a net profit surge of 1611% year-on-year [E63]. Furthermore, the business is conservatively financed with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.20x [E38] and shrinking borrowings of Rs 353 Cr down from Rs 420 Cr a year earlier [E39], alongside positive institutional accumulation from both foreign and domestic entities [E42, E43, E44]. conceded: [E50], [E52], [E59], [E60], [E61].
